hypotheses.S1_more_discovery_data_improves_natural_: At ridge 1e-4, increasing discovery states from 1024 to 8192 improves median natural rank-four R-squared at every layer.
hypotheses.S2_ridge_stabilizes_small_sample_fit: At 1024 discovery states, ridge 0.01 improves median natural rank-four R-squared over ridge 1e-4 at every layer.
hypotheses.S3_stable_cleaning_reaches_high_correlat: With 8192 discovery states, some predeclared ridge gives median natural rank-four score correlation at least 0.90 at every layer.
hypotheses.S4_natural_gaussian_gap_survives: At 8192 states and ridge 0.01, every layer's median natural rank-four R-squared remains at least 0.20 below Gaussian R-squared.
hypotheses.S5_no_universal_rank4_setting: No single sample-count/ridge setting gives rank-four natural correlation at least 0.90 for all twelve layer/components.
hypotheses.S6_second_moment_mismatch_predicts_failu: Across all layer/settings, held-out second-moment mismatch correlates at least 0.50 with negative median natural rank-four R-squared.
